title: 2PCS Motion Sensor Night Light RGB Colors Changing Rechargeable Magnetic Wall Lamp Sconce 3000K 1500mAh Battery For Entryway Hallway Bedroom Black
body_html: 1、3 Modes: Enjoy 3 lighting modes with our RGB wall light, solid color, amber, and multi color cycle. The top and bottom of the light can be controlled independently to display different colors and effects. 2、Easy to Operate: Our wall light comes with 2 round buttons that allow you to customize the colors of the top and bottom. Choose a specific color or let it cycle through the RGB spectrum for bright and colorful lighting in hallways and other spaces. 3、Colorful Gradient Light: With a simple press, our wall light instantly dazzles with colorful gradient effects. Switch between effects easily with a short touch, adding a touch of magic to any room. 4、Effortless Installation: Say goodbye to drilling and wiring worries with our magnetic wall light. The magnetic design makes installation quick and easy, saving you time and effort. 5、Wide Application: Our motion sensor night light is energy saving, low power consumption.
